panel.privacy.title: Privacy
panel.privacy.summary: Your data stays on your device. No analytics, no tracking.
panel.privacy.onDeviceBody: Routes and settings are stored on this device.
panel.privacy.thirdPartyBody: The map is assembled from public sources — OpenFreeMap, Mapterhorn, Esri and ogis.app — all loaded over HTTPS. As with any web request, those servers see your IP address, and the area you are viewing can be inferred from the tiles requested.

locate.hint.idle: Tap here to show where you are on the map.
locate.hint.active: That's you. Tap again and the map will follow you as you move.
locate.hint.following: The map is following you. Tap again to stop.
locate.hint.heading: Compass is off. Tap here or the map to turn it back on.
modal.locate.permissionBody: Permission is required to access your current location and compass heading. Your location is only used on this device. When prompted, please permit both.
modal.locate.unavailableBody: Your device could not determine a location. Check that location services are enabled and try again.
modal.locate.timeoutBody: No location arrived in time. Try again when you have a clearer view of the sky.
modal.locate.unsupportedBody: This browser does not provide location access.
modal.locate.unknownBody: Something went wrong while acquiring your location. Try again.
modal.locate.deniedIntro: The app was unable to acquire your location, possibly due to a previous denial of permission. To re-enable it, try:
modal.locate.tryOne: Reload this page and try again.
modal.locate.tryTwo: Search the web for: "allow geolocation after denial <your-browser> <your-device>".
modal.locate.tryThree: Wait a while, then try again.
